heading: Application to Controller for eviction of tenant
title: Application to Controller for eviction of tenant
text: A landlord may apply to the Controller for an order directing the tenant to put the landlord in possession of the premises if: (a) the tenant has failed to pay rent within sixty days of due date; (b) the tenant has handed over possession to any other person without written consent; (c) the tenant has used premises for purpose other than that for which it was let; (d) the landlord requires the premises in good faith for his own occupation or that of his spouse or children.

heading: Arrears of rent and striking off defence for non-payment
title: Arrears of rent and striking off defence for non-payment
text: The Controller shall, after filing of written statement, direct the tenant to pay all admitted arrears of rent and continue depositing monthly rent before the tenth day of each calendar month. If the tenant fails to deposit arrears or monthly rent within the time specified, the Controller shall strike off the defence of the tenant and pass an order directing the tenant to deliver vacant possession to the landlord.

heading: Appeal to High Court
title: Appeal to High Court
text: Any party aggrieved by a final order of the Controller may, within thirty days of the date of the order, prefer an appeal to the High Court.
